scripts.check: ultracite check --deny-warnings && pnpm test:local && pnpm typecheck:local && pnpm build:local && pnpm service:check
scripts.service:web-build: pnpm --filter @lenso/console-bridge build && pnpm --filter @lenso/console-system-plane build && tsc -b && VITE_API_BASE_URL=/ vite build
scripts.service:serve: pnpm service:web-build && cargo run --locked --manifest-path service/Cargo.toml --bin lenso-console-serve

scripts.test:local: vitest run src/app/router.test.ts src/app/console-auth.test.tsx src/app/console-composition.test.ts packages/console-bridge/src/index.test.ts packages/console-system-plane/src scripts/console-service-delivery.test.mjs scripts/console-service-release.test.mjs scripts/repository-boundary.test.mjs
